summary: Thirteen MDP members of Parliament filed a motion on 3 August 2026 for a vote of no confidence in Mohamed Saeed, Minister of Economic Development, Transport and Trade, asking that he be removed from office under Article 101(a) of the Constitution. They argued that he broke his constitutional duties as a Cabinet member and avoided answering to Parliament. Parliament voted on the motion on 4 November 2026 and rejected it: 10 members voted yes and 54 voted no.
keyPoints: The motion says the Minister failed to give clear answers to Parliament, including on USD 400 million he had said would come from bunkering services in the first year
It says State money was spent on investor forums abroad (including Dubai, India, Singapore and the UK) without disclosing any resulting investments or the costs

It lists promised projects it says were not delivered: the Ihavandhippolhu economic zone, a transshipment port in Funadhoo (Kaafu), the Digital Bank of Maldives, and the USD 8.8 billion Maldives International Financial Centre
It also criticises the merger of SDFC into the Bank of Maldives, the amendment to the Special Economic Zones Act and a 'Golden Visa' residency-by-investment scheme
Vote on 4 November 2026: 68 present, 10 yes, 54 no, 0 abstain, 3 eligible members did not vote
outcome: Rejected by Parliament (10 yes, 54 no) on 4 November 2026
